page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.16xlarge is a storage-intensive virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. A key hardware highlight is the inclusion of 7679 GB of local SSD storage, paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core execution is robust, achieving average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests, with a strong top 25% performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth and database operations also perform in the average tier.

Given the massive 7.6 TB local SSD storage bundled directly with 64 dedicated vCPUs, this instance offers high resource density for storage-heavy workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring high-capacity local scratch space or fast local read/write access without the overhead of external block storage. The hardware profile is best suited for databases, multi-threaded data processing, static web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that can leverage parallel processing and require substantial local storage.
